english.note: Use this more explicit form when you want to contrast a toenail with a fingernail.

examples.english: The doctor asked whether I had injured a fingernail or a toenail, and I said it was a toenail.
examples.traditional: 醫生問我係手指甲定腳指甲撞傷，我話係腳指甲。
